With RS-485 (CAN) output, the ASH-100 easily integrates into vehicle management systems, allowing seamless data transfer for real-time tracking and enhanced fleet control.
Avoid overloading penalties and ensure compliance with load regulations. ASH-100 provides accurate load data that enhances driver and vehicle safety, protecting assets and reducing maintenance costs.
Built to withstand rugged environments, the ASH-100 performs reliably under various conditions, delivering consistent, high-quality data for continuous fleet operations.

Atlanta FSH-10 supports a range of output interfaces—pulses, RS232, RS485, K-Line, and CAN—allowing easy integration with different monitoring systems. Choose the ideal interface for your setup and ensure seamless data flow across platforms.
The IP67 casing safeguards the FSH-10 against dust and water, making it ideal for rugged applications in construction, agriculture, mining, and transportation, where durability is a must.
Equipped with high-precision sensors, FSH-10 delivers precise fuel flow measurements, empowering operators to monitor consumption trends, reduce waste, and enhance operational efficiency.

The FSK-1000 leverages Bluetooth 4.2 technology, enabling seamless, secure wireless data transmission. Easily access real-time fuel level data from your smartphone or tablet for quick, data-driven decisions.

Powered to last, the FSK-1000 provides up to 5 years of battery life, ensuring reliable performance without frequent maintenance. This extended battery life reduces operational downtime and enhances monitoring consistency.

The FSK-1000 is designed for straightforward installation and hassle-free maintenance. Ideal for remote locations and challenging environments, it’s built to operate reliably without constant servicing.

The LSK-1000 utilizes a 2.4 GHz radio frequency for secure, interference-resistant communication, enabling real-time tilt data transmission over a stable connection. Perfect for remote monitoring without wiring hassles.
Designed for rugged use, the LSK-1000’s IP67-rated casing ensures complete protection against dust and water, making it suitable for outdoor and industrial environments that demand high durability.
Engineered with advanced sensing technology, the LSK-1000 provides precise tilt and angle readings to help improve machine stability, safety, and positioning accuracy in complex setups.
